title: Normalization commutes with completion away from the special fibre
statement:
Let $(A,\mathfrak m)$ be a Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] with completion $\widehat A$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Let $X	o\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ be locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism] and put $Y=X	imes_{\operatorname{Spec}(A)}\operatorname{Spec}(\widehat A)$ [def-pc-fibre-product, def-weil-affine-spectrum]. For a scheme $W$, write $W^
u	o W$ for its normalization: the disjoint union of the function-field normalizations of the irreducible components of $W$ with their reduced structures [def-weil-pbc-reduced-normalization]. If the complement of the special fibre (the inverse image of the closed point of $\operatorname{Spec}(\widehat A)$) in $Y$ is normal [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring], then the normalization $X^
u	o X$ is finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism] and its base change $X^
u	imes_{\operatorname{Spec}(A)}\operatorname{Spec}(\widehat A)	o Y$ is isomorphic over $Y$ to the normalization $Y^
u	o Y$.
